project.name: CE-EXOP
project.objective: Bootstrap the extended operation portfolio, scalable geometry, and profiler-readiness campaign without implementation.

invariants.rule: Never reset, clean, stash, overwrite, delete, silently attribute, or discard user or sibling-agent work.
CE-GEO adds uniquely prefixed tasks, runs, decisions, interfaces, evidence, and coordination records without replacing or reopening historical project state, including CE-PTR.
Shape never establishes biological equivalence; domain, order, geometry, partition, structure identity and epoch, and value generation remain explicit.
Immutable topology and mutable values retain independent identities, lifetimes, storage, and invalidation.
Portable semantic geometry is distinct from device-specific physical projection bytes, padding, and schedules.
Every logical edge has exactly one semantic owner and exactly one physical contributing owner.
Physical padding has no biological identity and is never a logical work item or edge.
CSG1 contains no architecture, device, provider-kernel, matrix-instruction, pointer, stream, runtime-handle, or mutable-generation identity.
CPE2 remains the device-specific execution image and embeds the exact portable semantic geometry bytes.
CPE2 v2 header, section-entry, and projection-entry sizes remain 256, 64, and 64 bytes and existing v1 readers remain valid.
CPK1 wire bytes and v1 semantics, including row_active_block_references, remain unchanged.
CP-BP remains an operational sparse-oriented strategy and compatibility path, not a universal MMA representation or optimizer constraint.
The existing end-to-end planner remains the sole final candidate-selection authority.
Preparation, conversion, transfer, value pack, input order, residual, epilogue, synchronization, canonicalization, and reuse costs remain visible.
A complete exact pure-sparse candidate remains available for every MMA-evaluated operation.
New MMA and fusion candidates are empirical-required and cannot enter automatic normal-catalog promotion without clean complete-cost evidence.
Evaluated non-promotion is valid; negative results and mechanism evidence are preserved.
Cellerator rearranges work only within the caller-supplied axis-qualified work window.
Full physical reorder and regroup freedom is the cheap default unless explicit cold caller constraints restrict it.
Work-layout optimization introduces no epoch, sampler, trainer, loss, optimizer, generic autograd, or model-policy ownership.
Internal packed order may persist across compatible operations; canonicalization is explicit, justified, and costed.
Hardware and provider discovery, selection, manifest inspection, and projection activation occur before preparation and never in hot kernels.
Capability records advertise implemented source-linked code, not documented but unimplemented ISA features.
WMMA fragments and architecture-private register layouts never cross public headers, provider contracts, artifacts, or mixed-architecture translation-unit boundaries.
Production sm_70 MMA owns output rectangles, accumulates through K, stores once, and uses no per-tile output atomics.

Sealed steady state performs no allocation, device discovery, geometry search, image parsing, descriptor construction, provider lookup, host sorting, hidden canonicalization, or device-wide synchronization.
Operand conversion, storage, accumulation, output, determinism, rounding, approximation, NaN and Inf behavior are explicit candidate policies.
No biological edge is removed to satisfy structured sparsity or accelerator convenience.
New scientific provider kernels do not silently inherit global fast-math, cache-policy, register-cap, or launch-bound flags.
New CE-GEO production APIs and implementations avoid STL ownership and allocator-heavy container graphs.
CE-GEO neither duplicates, certifies, nor blocks on CE-PTR; it revalidates shared interfaces after concurrent changes.
One versioned data-only semantic strategy boundary is the sole future optimizer extension point; no second optimizer API or frozen binary plugin ABI is introduced.
CellShard, BioPrep, Baseplane, and adapters use only public generic Cellerator contracts and receive no privileged internal access.
Cellerator provides reusable biological operations while GlassHelix owns model architecture, loss, training behavior, latent semantics, and dynamical theory.
All feasible sm_70 foundation, implementation, validation, and evidence work completes before CE-AMP may begin.
CE-AMP remains blocked until CE-GEO-COMPLETE and explicit human-controlled CE-AMP-PERMISSION equals granted; no automated actor may change it.
Parallel tasks own exact files or narrow modules; shared manifests, registries, exports, and docs belong only to designated integration or documentation tasks.
Behavior changes update the existing authoritative documentation spine and do not create a competing architecture.
Never reset, clean, stash, overwrite, delete, or silently attribute user or sibling-agent work.
Bootstrap adds CE-EXOP and revises only the explicitly authorized CE-AMP prerequisites.
CE-EXOP consumes completed CE-GEO and CE-PTR architecture rather than recreating either campaign.
Portable biological geometry remains separate from target-specific physical cover and projection.
Every local logical edge has exactly one semantic owner and one physical contributing owner.
The planner remains the sole candidate-selection authority.
Optimizer and kernel portfolios expose alternatives; CE-EXOP freezes no universal winner before profiling.
Correct profiler-ready candidates are completion-worthy while performance promotion remains deferred.
Every relation-algebra primitive remains independently callable and planner-visible.
Every fused path preserves profiler-visible unfused components.
Experimental candidates are explicitly requestable and distinguishable, not hidden in benchmark-only source.
Distinct candidate mechanisms have distinct stable IDs and human-readable kernel and stage names.
Mechanism, resource, and stage metadata are constructed before execution.
Disabled profiling adds no kernel counters, dynamic strings, allocation, hardware discovery, or stage search to the hot path.
Global biological IDs and aggregate counts are 64-bit; local physical indices remain compact where valid.
No operation is rejected solely because aggregate global relation size exceeds UINT32_MAX.
Very large relations use exact local components or chunks with recoverable global identity.
No potentially large relation, edge, support, work-window, or value path uses quadratic duplicate search or repeated global scans.
Cellerator exposes generic partition, order, and resource metadata without importing CellShard or owning distributed placement.
All relation-algebra operations have real operation-core v2 semantics and no rejected placeholder enum values.
Program v2 is the sole internal production execution engine.
Any retained v1 entry is a compatibility wrapper, not a second production engine.
Compiled provider inclusion, detected hardware, and tuning policy are separate.
Scientific kernels do not silently inherit global approximate math policy.
Projection-primary trainable values preserve exact logical identity and shared generation semantics.
Physical padding and zero holes have no biological identity and are never trainable.
Projection-primary gradients need not canonicalize before update.
Compatible operations may retain physical order until an explicit boundary.
Dynamic gates over stable support do not masquerade as topology changes.
No trainer, epoch, loss, optimizer, model scheduler, or general tensor framework enters Cellerator.
Sparse exchange remains a composition of relation operations, not a public attention abstraction.
Every MMA-capable operation retains a complete legal sparse path.
No biological edge is deleted to satisfy hardware structure.
Implement broad differentiated Volta access while deferring exhaustive Nsight-driven microtuning.
No extensive dataset search or download is part of CE-EXOP.
The complete Cellerator plus CellShard Nsight campaign remains an explicit follow-up.
No preprint-grade performance claim is required or implied by CE-EXOP.
Every CE-AMP task requires CE-EXOP-COMPLETE in addition to explicit human permission.
Implementation lanes own exact files or narrow modules; shared manifests are integration-owned.
First-class Codex agents own lanes; local workers are subordinate children only.
Implemented behavior updates the authoritative documentation spine without creating a competing architecture.

boundaries: Cellerator remains single-GPU usable and CellShard-independent.
CSG1 semantic geometry remains separate from CPE2 physical projections.
Program v2 and planner authority own internal production selection.
Deep profiling, biological data, preprint claims, sm86, and CE-AMP remain deferred.
All implementation starts later through first-class coding-workflow lanes.
acceptance_conditions: All required tasks and frozen interfaces reach allowed dispositions.
Synthetic and adversarial host and Volta evidence prove correctness, scale, stage identity, and profiler readiness.
CE-EXOP-COMPLETE is reached without changing CE-AMP-PERMISSION or starting CE-AMP.
charter.local_worker_boundary: Local workers remain subordinate to one claimed parent and own no lane, interface, rendezvous, or completion.

content.summary: Architecture, scope, CE-GEO and CE-PTR inheritance, and stable invariants.
Hierarchical indexing, chunking, local and global identity, and linear complexity.
Semantic strategies, target strategies, exact oracle, and Pareto portfolio.
Relation algebra, values, gradients, gates, bundles, chains, and independent primitives.
Volta candidate inventory, exact residuals, stable symbols, and no deep microtuning.
Cold mechanism manifests, resource receipts, stage IDs, and deferred Nsight work.
Structural, numerical, scale, sanitizer, graph, and sealed-hot-path requirements.
Dataset search, CellShard joint profiling, CE-AMP, and preprint work remain future.
